title: Relucent
summary: RELU'CENT, adjective [Latin relucens, relucco; re and lucco, to shine.] Shining; transparent; clear; pellucid; as a relucent stream.

inlines.v: RELU'CENT, adjective [Latin relucens, relucco; re and lucco, to shine.] Shining; transparent; clear; pellucid; as a relucent stream.
